steps.caption: Open Deal toolkit from the sidebar.
How to read this page opens a short guide to every box and label on this screen.
Buy for ₹120 crore plus 7% stamp duty; 1 lakh sq ft leasable.
Tenancy schedule: two tenants, with expiry, vacant months and re-let rent.
Running costs, then hold 7 years and sell at an 8% exit cap rate; discount at 12%.
Debt is optional: tick it to add a loan and see levered returns and DSCR.
Calculate & save — fixed formulas, not AI.
IRR: the yearly return on the money put in. NPV: value in today's money at your 12% rate.
Negative NPV means the return is below 12%; equity multiple is cash back ÷ cash in.
Cash flows by year: rent, costs, net operating income — and the sale in the final year.
Sensitivities: how IRR and NPV move if the exit cap or rent change.
Assumptions are written out, e.g. how the exit value is worked out.
How we calculated this: the formula version and every step, so anyone can check the maths.
Each save is a version. Change any input and recalculate — earlier versions are kept, never overwritten.
Download deck makes an editable PowerPoint of these results for the client.
